changes.after: (a) The Council is a working cabinet, not a competing ladder of native ranks. Twelve reserved portfolios serve beneath the Guild Master as chair: the Co-Guild Master and Hand of the Sovereign; Lord High Treasurer; Lord High Chancellor and Head of Justice; Grand Marshal of PvE; Grand Marshal of PvP; High Inquisitor and Minister of Internal Security; High Minister of the Chancery and Imperial Census; Grand Concordat Director; Grand Master Artisan; Minister of Propaganda; Lord High Herald; and the dedicated Head of Trading & Markets. The Sovereign may establish further distinct portfolios through an explicit instrument. No published list supplies a holder, a vote or a second native High Council rank. The Addon / Discord Architect serves outside the Council as an Officer Corps technical specialist. The Minister of Propaganda directs creative campaigns, recruitment storytelling and broadcaster-safe promotion; Heraldry retains official records and publication standards. Neither title grants publishing access or a Council vote without the separate accepted authority.

changes.before: The retained chart distinguishes PvP and Raiding portfolios; the current War Head guide centers organized PvE progression, with PvP an optional activity remit. Neither appointments nor warrants are changed. The Federal Treasurer carries the finance portfolio. The Ministers of Artisanry and Heraldry carry the crafting and community portfolios. Accepted High Councillors without another portfolio ordinarily serve the Council of Justice, subject to case designation and conflict review. Systems and Addons is a shared support division with a recorded lead; it is not an undeclared fifth ministry. Specialist service heads may advise the Council without becoming voting Council members unless separately appointed.

Display ranks are 1–10; zero-based native slots are 0–9. High Council is Rank 2 / Slot 1; Officer Rank 3 / Slot 2; Officer Alt Rank 4 / Slot 3. Co-Guild Master and Treasurer are appointments within the Leader / High Council tier, not additional native ranks. The [Olympus Role & Rank Rosetta Stone](#/roles/rosetta-stone) joins the current guide and all 101 stable offices / 137 assignable keys. Historical beta-five game observations and older ladder proposals are dated technical history, not competing current recommendations.
